ctx.x: Yeah. That’s what I used to do a lot. I used to think I was having fun dropping beats. That was — my Bill Evans friends used to make me screw the time up all the time. But the best one is “Contrasts” I think. And we never got something that was representative of what we were doing for those ten years. But I think “Contrasts,” the newest one that we made for Arbors, which is just the two of us, came out last year, is more of us both as musicians. This is more Bucky’s leader and I do what I do. that. And then he started to play “Nuages” and he’s looking at me like, “you going to play now?” I’m going I ain’t going to play. You play. You go. You play. You’re on. And he’s best when he’s been playing over a long period of time. Like when you hear his group with John Bunch and Jay Leonhart, that’s the only group I want to go hear.
